answer: Bindings are kept in jade, verified in vault, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the jetty check. A farm of 4981 identities would post 2485 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
